material: CPVC wetted, per AQS-STD-002 rules M2 and M5: liquor 70–85 °C (graph liquor_T_C 77.5 °C) is above PVC-U 60 °C and inside CPVC 93 °C. No metal wetted part. Wall 16 mm, floor 16 mm (AQS-DUTY-050), three external FRP belts. PVDF lid bolts. HX-5 is a borosilicate glass 3.3 coil, 4.22 m² (AQS-DUTY-049 natural-convection case, 7.941 kW rated), two concentric helices of 25 × 3 mm tube, 53.7 m, on PTFE pads, entering through CPVC stubs at N6a/N6b with FKM gaskets (AQS-STD-002 section 3.3); the Q3 metal piping ends at a dielectric isolating flange outside the tank. Liquor high-temperature trip 88 °C (assumption). Wall checked at 85 °C in AQS-DUTY-050.
